description: This header provides utility functions for CLI11-based command-line interface parsing, including adding options, subcommands, and handling special cases like auto enums and optional types within the ocudu namespace.

methods.name: get_first_option_name
methods.description: Extracts the first option name from a comma-separated list of option names.

methods.name: add_subcommand
methods.description: Adds a subcommand to a CLI11 application if it does not already exist.

methods.name: add_option
methods.description: Adds or replaces an option in a CLI11 application, with support for various types.

methods.name: add_option_function
methods.description: Adds a custom function to be called during option parsing.

methods.name: add_option_cell
methods.description: Adds an option that handles a list of strings (cell).

methods.name: lexical_cast
methods.description: Converts a string into an optional typed value.

methods.name: add_auto_enum_option
methods.description: Adds an integer or 'auto' option that maps to an enum type.
